course_name: Honours Diploma in Computer Hardware and Network
objective: This course ensures a strong career foundation in the hardware and networking sector. It emphasizes practical knowledge and provides detailed understanding of computer basics, internet, digital electronics, hardware, and networking concepts. It prepares students for entry-level computer engineering and networking jobs by building technical and professional skills.

G-TEC Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) validates the ability to plan, implement, verify, and troubleshoot local and wide-area enterprise networks, and to work collaboratively on advanced security, voice, wireless, and video solutions. It is suitable for candidates with at least one year of networking experience and prepares them for advanced enterprise networking roles such as network technician, support engineer, systems engineer, or network engineer.

course_name: Advanced Diploma In Hardware and Networking
objective: The Advanced Diploma in Hardware and Networking prepares students for careers in computer hardware repair and network administration. The course emphasizes hands-on training in computer systems, networking, internet technologies, and basic electronics. It builds technical, analytical, and teamwork skills required for roles in hardware and network engineering.

The G-TEC Certified Laptop Engineering course is designed to develop confidence, skills, and expertise in the laptop service industry. It provides both theoretical knowledge and practical training in laptop hardware, troubleshooting, and chip-level servicing.

course_name: Diploma in Mobile Phone Technology & Tablet Engineering
objective: This course is designed for students and professionals who want to build a career in mobile phone technology. It covers servicing of all major smartphone brands, including both hardware and software repair. Training begins with basic electronics and progresses to advanced troubleshooting and chip-level diagnostics.

course_outline.module: Parts and Their Functions in Mobile Phones
Mobile Phone Repairing and Testing Methods
Mobile Phone Reset and Secret Codes
Lock Removal (FRP, Pattern, Country, SIM Lock)

course_name: Diploma in Mobile Phone, CCTV & Computer Hardware Technology
objective: This diploma program is designed to provide technical knowledge and practical skills in mobile phone repair, CCTV installation, and computer hardware maintenance. It prepares students for careers in the electronics and IT hardware sectors through hands-on training and applied learning.

course_outline.module: Advanced Mobile Phone Repair (Android and iOS)

course_name: Advanced Diploma in Desktop and Laptop Chip Level Engineering
objective: The Advanced Diploma in Desktop and Laptop Chip Level Engineering provides practical and theoretical knowledge in computer repair. Students gain hands-on experience in diagnosing and fixing hardware and software issues in both desktops and laptops, preparing them for careers as skilled technicians in the computer service industry.

course_outline.module: Advanced Desktop and Laptop Chip Level Training

course_name: Advanced Diploma in Mobile Phone Technology
objective: This comprehensive program equips learners with in-depth knowledge and practical skills in mobile phone repair, maintenance, and advanced technological upgrades. It prepares individuals to become experts in mobile technology, enabling them to troubleshoot, repair, and enhance the functionality of modern smartphones.

course_outline.module: Basic Electronics, Motherboard, Operating System & SMD
Mobile Phone Assembling and Disassembling, Repairing Testing Methods & Software Servicing
iPhone and Android IC Programming and Mobile Phone Repairing
Deep-Level Practical Training in Software Flashing (iOS, Android)
Deep-Level Practical Training in Mobile Phone Chip-Level Fault Finding
